items.title: What platforms will Glasshouse be on?
items.description: We are initially launching on Steam (PC/Mac), with console versions planned for later in 2025.

items.title: When is the release date?
items.description: We are targeting a late 2024 release. Wishlist on Steam to be notified the moment we launch.

items.title: Is there a playable demo?
items.description: A public demo will be available during the upcoming Steam Next Fest.

items.title: What are the system requirements?
items.description: Glasshouse is optimized for mid-range PCs, requiring at least a GTX 1060 or equivalent for the best experience.

items.title: Does the game support controllers?
items.description: Yes, full controller support is implemented for Xbox, PlayStation, and Steam Deck.
